social_rules: All promises must be weighed by the Scales of Oaths before transit.
Silence Keepers may seize any asset if the promise-weight exceeds the owner's credit.
Couriers are forbidden from speaking the contents of the promises they carry.
The Voiceless Refusal Hall is the only neutral ground for debt negotiation.
Gravity-Ink Alchemists must certify all seals on promise-contracts.

visual_consistency_rules: Use thick, ink-brushed black outlines for all sprites.
